title: U2.4 phase-3 gate not yet satisfied by primary evidence: the fixed (c1b) acceptance code has never been exercised in a live 3-outer-run measurement, only replayed offline against c1's (pre-1b-fix) recorded raw proposals
evidence: qa/gates/speaker-segment-identity.md step 3 names an explicit protocol: 'run the frozen local qwen3:8b digest three times ... and require [the 5 bars]'. The only completed LIVE run under this fix cycle (run-results.c1.jsonl, 33/33 lines, 2340/2340 calls, 0 degraded, independently re-verified by the checker) used the PRE-1b acceptance code (commit range 6497719..b40327f) and scored {accepted:0,correct:0,precision:null,additions:0} -- a clean FAIL of every mandatory bar, re-derived by the checker via 05-score.mjs --tag c1. The claimed PASS numbers (precision 1 (12/12), wrongIdentities 0, wrongPairsRelational 0, additions 4, stableAll true) come from 08-replay.mts, which feeds c1's already-recorded raw model text through the NEW (1b) deterministic acceptance code -- byte-reproduced by the checker (run-results.c1-replay-checker.jsonl / measurement-summary.c1-replay-checker.json, identical to the manifest's numbers). buildSpeakerWindows (the only live-model-facing surface) is verified byte-unchanged since c1 (git diff b40327f..HEAD), so the replay is credible corroborating evidence that the 1b fix is correct against real historical model output -- but it never exercises the live provider path (ollama.ts, timeouts, a FRESH sampling of the frozen digest) with the actual 1b code, and ISS-255's own recorded finding is that this system's live output is NOT fully reproducible run-to-run even under matched settings, which is exactly the risk class an offline replay of old data cannot rule out for a fresh run.
